LanguageData.MST.haveSurpriseAttackComment: Whether this maneuver has additional effects during ambushes (e.g., the first attack when hunting humans). The editor does not support editing this item.
LanguageData.MST.EXdamageNumComment: Whether this maneuver has additional damage effects. The editor can only edit the first two extra effects and cannot add new ones, only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.EXdamageAmountBaseComment: The value of the extra damage effect attached to this maneuver. The editor cannot add new extra effects, only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.EXchanceComment: The chance of the extra damage effect attached to this maneuver. The editor cannot add new extra effects, only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.EXarmorPenetrationBaseComment: The armor penetration of the extra damage effect attached to this maneuver. If -1, it means the armor penetration is 15% of the damage, e.g., 10 damage corresponds to 15% armor penetration. The editor cannot add new extra effects, only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.EX2damageTypeComment: The damage type of the second extra damage effect. The editor cannot add new extra effects, only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.EX2damageAmountBaseComment: The value of the second extra damage effect. The editor cannot add new extra effects, only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.EX2chanceComment: The chance of the second extra damage effect. The editor cannot add new extra effects, only modify existing ones.
LanguageData.MST.EX2armorPenetrationBaseComment: The armor penetration of the second extra damage effect. If -1, it means the armor penetration is 15% of the damage, e.g., 10 damage corresponds to 15% armor penetration. The editor cannot add new extra effects, only modify existing ones.
